Page 126 Cont.
Feb. 10 Frank Kosarek - 63 - never sick till about 3 yrs. ago, now having had a stroke has become a real invalid - with vericose ulcers and badly swolen feet. Enrolled Today 1.00
Mr. Roy E. Trombley - 29 - was losing toes by inches from diabetis ... enrolled in October ... O.K. since.
Gray Margolf - 16 - in experiments Hosp'l Ann Arbor (Univ) sick since September - Drs just wonder (Boy) baptized of own accord last year. Grand Mother had been Catholic ....
Page 127
Feb. 20 Theresa Farmer - in oxigen - Talks only of going to heaven and her mother almost as enthusiastic as daughter.
Mary Zakrzewski - 28 -nerve-break last June on acc't of mother's death. Home from Retreat for about a week. Had to be sent away again lest she do violence.
Mrs. Mary Ferry - 58 - slight stroke Rose Mary Fisher - in confinement since - Monday ...
Bert Clanve - 61 - methodist, heart-trouble, serious pain in feet and quite short of breath.
Lillian Gothier - 58 - rheumatism
Feb. 23 Mrs. M. Barnett - 36 - Lutheran fears mastoid operation - enrolled; promises to look into relig .....
Page 128
Feb. 23 Harold R. Allen - 37 - methodest father of family - wife and two. Has been having trouble since birth with Epileptic seizures.
Cecelia Stein - 54 - Arthritis and nerves. Mrs. Pauline Gann - 21 - was presbiterian T.B. in
28 Mrs. Santa Ferrugia - 48 - mother of a family; had three operations on breast and now again threatened. Ebrolled To-day perpetually.
Elizabeth Gazdag - 41 - of Wyandotte - inflamation of brain for five months - very severe headaches last 3 mo's Enrolled Today 1.00
